reviews.title: Useless
reviews.text:
I’ve had this software installed on my mobile device for a year.
It’s quite literally worthless.
It scans my device to ensure security.. takes about 3 seconds and tells me all is good. My device memory is 256gb and 80% full. No proper security scan can determine safety of such a high amount of data in 3 seconds. Reality is that all it checks is if you’re device software is up to date.
If you use this app, clearly you’re selling your information to corporations since this app’s recommendation are “let Facebook use your personal information” so they can force adverts down your throat.
The trick to security is keeping your personal information “Personal” not to throw it away to any company with a string of apps and other rubbish to sell to you.
The one positive thing this app did, was remove some minor personal information that was up for sale on the deep web, but for what information they had (name, d.o.b, hometown) it really was not worth the £90 fee they charged for the year.
It also took about 4 months for the data to be removed. Which is absurd. Just as absurd as only having my data removed by request, when realistically a good security company would earn reputation having annihilated all the information that dark markets had for sale.
Seems internet security has come full circle. Now it’s ok to give your personal information to companies deemed “trusted” by the security company. Wonder how thick that crypto brown envelope is. Needless to say, the best form of security is c

Immediately, a message appeared from ‘McAfee’ saying they needed to scan my iPad immediately as they had detected an infected virus which I allowed in my panic.  It was a scam so now I am left with wondering whether the scammer has left a link to all my iPad’s content….
